Welcome to Starting Point - trusted, practical guidance for your baby or toddler’s motor development.

I’m Cyndi Stedman, PT, DPT, a pediatric physical therapist with more than 17 years of experience helping children and their families. I share simple, realistic strategies to help your child build strength, confidence, and new movement skills through everyday play.

You’ll find expert guidance about:

• Tummy time
• Rolling, sitting, crawling, standing, and walking
• Torticollis and head preference
• Low muscle tone
• Toe walking and flat feet
• Developmental delays
• When to seek additional support

Whether you’re wondering if your baby is on track or looking for activities you can try at home, Starting Point is here to give you clear answers and reassurance.

Subscribe for practical tips from a pediatric physical therapist, and download my free Birth-to-Walking Motor Milestone Guide using the link below.

🌐 https://www.startingpointpediatric.com/socials
